test-handoff.description: Test only: hand every pane to a new image of this binary, in place.

params.name: binary
params.description: The binary to exec. Omit for this one.

params.name: hold_ms
params.description: Wait this long after the manifest is written, before the clients are closed.

params.name: fork_in_window
params.description: Start a long-lived child while the descriptors are exposed.

params.name: swap_in_window
params.description: Two folders to swap by renames while the descriptors are exposed.

params.name: swap_after_check
params.description: Two folders to swap by renames between the preflight's checks and its run.

params.name: copy
params.description: Run a private copy of the binary, as systems without /proc/self/fd do, on Linux too.

test-handoff-stats.description: Test only: what the handoff that made this image measured.

test-quiesce.description: Test only: quiesce one pane and resume it, cycles times.

params.name: session
params.description: Session name. Omit from a pane for the pane's own session, and from outside every pane for the most recently active one.

params.name: window
params.description: Window id or name. Omit to target the focused window.
